scientific_role: development-only mathematical sensitivity; never a replacement confirmatory analysis

forbidden: promotion of S3, S4, or S5 to confirmation from development performance alone

common_design.preprocessing: pferi_v2_feature_preprocessing_contract_v1, refit inside each outer training fold
common_design.training_likelihood_weight: sqrt inverse inclusion probability normalized to mean one in each outer training fold
common_design.reporting_weight: full inverse inclusion probability Hajek-normalized within the evaluated set
common_design.posterior_intervals: Bayesian model intervals under the declared pseudo-likelihood; not design-based confidence intervals

S3.outer_test_prediction: posterior mean of inverse_logit(alpha + X_test beta)

S4.outer_test_prediction: marginal posterior probability for two previously unseen endpoints, integrating Normal(0, 2*sigma_image^2) with fixed 20-node Gauss-Hermite quadrature for every posterior draw
S4.prohibited_prediction: conditioning on training endpoint effects or treating test images as previously observed

S5.trigger_timing_limitation: numeric thresholds are frozen after Task15E development outcomes were open, so S5 cannot affect final route selection
S5.trigger_unit: each outer-training fold after frozen P5 preprocessing and removal of zero-variance design columns
trigger_if_any: training fitted probability below 1e-6 or above 0.999999
S5.if_not_triggered: record NOT_TRIGGERED and do not fit Firth/FLIC
S5.if_triggered: run Firth with FLIC intercept correction only as a labelled diagnostic; it cannot replace P3, P5, S1, S2, S3, or S4

checks: both outcome classes receive nonzero prior predictive probability
prior definitions exactly match the frozen contract
prior_predictive_gate.prohibited: changing priors in response to observed Task15F posterior performance

mcmc.retry_policy: one prespecified retry at target_accept 0.99 and 3000 tune draws only when the first run fails a convergence gate; retain both attempts

convergence_gates.failed_fold_policy: model sensitivity does not qualify; never silently omit or replace the fold

interpretation_rules.S3_question: whether P5 fixed-effect direction and uncertainty remain coherent under an outcome-independent weak prior
interpretation_rules.S4_question: whether shared endpoint-image dependence materially changes fixed effects or honest new-image predictions
interpretation_rules.S5_question: whether classical separation requires a labelled diagnostic rescue
interpretation_rules.not_allowed: choosing the final model by the lowest Task15F development Brier
interpretation_rules.next_gate: Task15G exploratory performance-bound benchmark, followed by Task15H qualification-before-performance freeze
